# Reportable fringe benefits
This is regardless of whether the benefits provided are type 1 or type 2. So, for example, if an employee receives certain fringe benefits with a total taxable value of $2,000.01 for the FBT year ending 31 March 2026, the reportable fringe benefits amount is $3,773.
